statement: Let f be real-valued on an interval containing H consecutive integers. If f′ is monotone and remains in [j + λ, j + 1 − λ] for an integer j and 0 < λ ≤ 1/2, then X n e(f(n)) ≪ λ−1 . If instead f is twice continuously differentiable and λ ≤ |f′′| ≤ Cλ throughout the interval, then X n e(f(n)) ≪C H √ λ + λ−1/2 . Both estimates apply on every subinterval satisfying their hypotheses.
